d:
Lok aastha ka mahaparv chhath keval suryadev aur chhathi maeeya ki upasna ka parv nahin hai, balki yah prakriti ke prati kritagyata, shuddhata, samarpan aur sanatan paranpraon ka bhi pratik hai. char dinon tak chalne vale is mahaparv men vrati puri nishtha aur pavitrata ke sath bhagvan sury ko arghy arpit karte hain.
